rationale.position: Existing checkpoint regression budget; 4e-8 of a 25 um cell. Record measured differences and bin-boundary crossings separately.
rationale.velocity: Existing global proper-velocity regression budget. Mass, charge, weights and identity remain exact.
rationale.fields: Conservative integration regression budget, not a production solver tolerance. 1e-10 of each global component plus 256 epsilon V_scale/h for derivative cancellation. The corresponding e/m E_error window impulse is reported against the velocity budget.
rationale.ledger: 1024 epsilon times the appropriate full charge/energy scale, rather than relative error of a cancellation residual near zero.
rationale.density: Validate each CSV against that checkpoint particle deposition; permit only roundoff or particle-bin/slab-boundary changes explained by matched, position-qualified particles. No blanket absolute density threshold.
rationale.time: 64 epsilon times the global clock scale, with a 1e-23 s floor reflecting the existing nonprogress guard. Pairwise clocks/options/counts remain exact.

history.cadence: wall-clock reports; unmatched intermediate rows validated independently but not compared by interpolation

density_analysis.basis: Each saved density independently reconstructed from its own particles; paired identity/weight/position checks constrain bin changes. Different occupancy bins are not inferred crossing events.

limits: Checkpoint has no nodal potential or crossing-event log; field comparison is limited to final saved CSV cell centers.
Only matching history steps are compared; no unrecorded intermediate state is inferred.
Saved residual norms are checked against CPU-reconstructed RHS guards; residual error vectors and solver maximum-relative history are not saved.
This is a short-window integration regression comparison, not physical, grid or timestep convergence.
CPU7 proof is recorded allocation/receipt evidence; no live production/cgroup state is changed or inferred.
